create.name: Cynthia Bourgeault
create.bio:
Cynthia Bourgeault is an Episcopal priest, writer and teacher of Christian contemplation who lives on the coast of Maine, splitting her days between a small island hermitage and the village of Stonington, often crossing between them in her own boat. Raised near Philadelphia, she first met silence in Quaker meetings at school, later took a doctorate in medieval studies with a focus on early music, and was ordained in 1979.

A ten-day retreat with Thomas Keating in 1990 changed her course: she became his pupil, then his editor and finally a colleague for some thirty years. The hermit Raphael Robin showed her how to join the monastic path with the self-observation of the Gurdjieff Work, and in 1999 she gave the first of her Wisdom Schools in British Columbia. Her books, among them The Wisdom Jesus, The Heart of Centering Prayer, Mystical Hope and Eye of the Heart, explore Centering Prayer, the inner side of Christianity and what she calls the imaginal realm. Today the Wisdom Waypoints network carries her work, with online courses such as a five-week Introductory Wisdom School, live talks and free recorded teachings. She is also emeritus faculty at the Center for Action and Contemplation.

books.title: The Wisdom Jesus: Transforming Heart and Mind
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: Her best-known introduction to Jesus as a teacher of inner transformation, read through the Christian Wisdom tradition.

books.title: The Heart of Centering Prayer: Nondual Christianity in Theory and Practice
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: Instruction in Centering Prayer together with her account of what shifts in perception during the practice.

books.title: The Wisdom Way of Knowing: Reclaiming an Ancient Tradition to Awaken the Heart
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: A short gateway book on Wisdom as a deeper, whole-person way of knowing, and the practices that support it.

books.title: The Holy Trinity and the Law of Three
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: A rethinking of the Trinity in the light of Gurdjieff's Law of Three, as a pattern of ongoing creation.

books.title: The Meaning of Mary Magdalene
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: A study of Mary Magdalene as a disciple and spiritual partner of Jesus, drawing on the Gospels and early texts.

books.title: Mystical Hope: Trusting in the Mercy of God
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: A brief book on hope as an inner presence found in contemplative practice rather than an expectation of outcomes.

books.title: Eye of the Heart: A Spiritual Journey into the Imaginal Realm
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: Her exploration of the imaginal realm known to the mystical traditions and how to perceive it with the heart.

books.title: Love Is Stronger Than Death: The Mystical Union of Two Souls
books.author: Cynthia Bourgeault
books.description: Her first book, on her spiritual partnership with the hermit Raphael Robin and what continued after his death.

courses.title: Introductory Wisdom School
courses.description: A newly filmed five-week online course introducing the Christian Wisdom tradition, from Benedictine prayer and work to Gurdjieff's three-centred awareness.

courses.title: A Teaching with Cynthia Bourgeault: Eye of the Heart
courses.description: A live ninety-minute Zoom session in which she teaches on the imaginal realm from her book, with centring practice and time for questions; recorded for all who sign up.

free_resources.title: Metis Teaching by Cynthia Bourgeault
free_resources.description: A recorded talk from a Wisdom School in Ontario on métis, the skill of acting rightly in the moment from three-centred awareness.
